invariants: Every event pins one exact expression, manifestation and manifestation digest.
Mutable URL, latest alias or policy-work reference alone cannot prove what was communicated.
Acknowledging a translated manifestation does not assert acknowledgement of the authentic-language expression.
Recipient identity and kind are explicit and never inferred from a delivery endpoint.
Delivery, opening, reading and acknowledgement are distinct outcomes.
Acknowledgement proves only the recorded act for the exact event it references.
Superseding an event never re-points an acknowledgement; a superseding acknowledgement references the same communication event.
A non-recipient actor is rejected or explicitly delegated and is never silently attributed to the recipient.
Acknowledgement never proves comprehension, consent, compliance or control effectiveness.
A retry creates a delivery attempt and never overwrites failure history.
Unknown event or delivery status remains unknown until externally evidenced and is never promoted.
A corrected event supersedes and never mutates the prior event.
Policy revision or exception expiry never rewrites communication history.
Unit recipients do not imply receipt or acknowledgement by members.
Retention and disposal are distinct from communication lifecycle.
No write path exists to policy resolution, control execution, effectiveness or risk closure.
